```lean
induction' s with x xs IH
· simp [prod_empty]
· have hxs : ∀ y ∈ xs, f y ≡ g y [MOD n] := by intro y hy; exact h y hy
  have hprod_xs : ∏ y ∈ xs, f y ≡ ∏ y ∈ xs, g y [MOD n] := IH hxs
  have hprod_x : f x ≡ g x [MOD n] := h x (by simp)
  have hprod_total : (∏ y ∈ xs, f y) * f x ≡ (∏ y ∈ xs, g y) * g x [MOD n] :=
    by rw [hprod_xs, hprod_x]; exact congr_arg (_root_.mul) rfl
  simp [prod_insert, hprod_total]
```
